title: Back to the Beach | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the charming Highland Park neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach, this coastal retreat offers the perfect setting for intimate family gatherings. With four bedrooms, an open-concept design, and space to comfortably sleep eight, it’s ideal for reconnecting with loved ones. The home’s inviting layout keeps everyone connected, while the screened-in porch provides a serene spot to relax with a morning coffee or evening glass of wine. Thoughtfully designed and equipped with everything needed for a seamless getaway, this home embodies laid-back coastal living at its finest. Located near the vibrant heart of Blue Mountain Beach, this home offers convenient access to the best of 30A. Spend sunny days at the nearby Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access or explore the scenic trails right in the backyard. A short bike ride away, you’ll find the community’s stunning resort-style pool or delightful spots like Blue Mountain Bakery, known for its irresistible cinnamon rolls. Whether enjoying a peaceful stroll, a day at the beach, or relaxing by the pool, this charming home is the perfect base for an unforgettable coastal escape.
